description: Lists a collection's items with search (q), status, filters (field, op eq, ne, contains, set or unset, value) and sort ("-publishedAt"), a page at a time (pageSize up to 100), with the total. Long text is cut: get_item reads one whole. Drafts included. With locale (a language from list_locales, on a translatable collection): values in that language, the default text where a translation is missing, and each item's translation state (missing, draft or published) and translated slug; search, filters and sort use the default values. Reads only.

branch.description: Optional branch; default the branch the workspace has open

collection.description: The collection id (its folder under content/), from list_collections

locale.description: Optional: a language code from list_locales (not the default) to read or write the item in that language; leave out for the default language

q.description: Search titles, slugs and text fields

sort.description: A field or system key ("title", "-publishedAt" for newest first); default the collection's sort

name: list_items
title: List CMS items
